title: Leaving Don Raymond's band for World War II service
summary: He left Don Raymond's band for the service about ten months after the war began.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years

blocks.x: And they tried to fake them. Well I think I took more interest in the instrument when I went to the service. I left Don Raymond's band going to service. That was World War II.
Yeah, but what year is it, 40?
Well it was not quite a year.
Yeah, just about 10 months after the war began.
